# utf8proc provenance

This directory contains the complete utf8proc 2.12.0 source release from
<https://github.com/JuliaStrings/utf8proc> at commit
`79cdd5ab40c79afa559f689ffc13b76812dee1ac` (the commit referenced by the
`v2.12.0` tag).

The upstream files are unmodified. `meson.build` and this provenance note are
local integration files.
